decision.reason: The public upload path can create a run-owned VST source and synchronously request video embeddings, but it cannot request the predecessor's digest-pinned sensor/object identity, RTVI-CV registration is best-effort on connection failures, attribute results require successful VST identity resolution, the shipped profile fixes behavior/raw index names while the predecessor derives per-run index names, and video deletion is a best-effort multi-system operation without an exact rollback receipt. Direct Elasticsearch document creation alone is therefore not a functional or exactly cleanable full Search fixture.

actions.postcondition: regular non-symlink file, stable size, reviewed SHA-256
run-derived filename absent and exact document tuples absent; foreign sentinel unchanged
exact VST upload path returned on an admitted numeric-loopback origin
VST allocates and returns a sensorId; the caller cannot request the predecessor's fixed sensorId
positive chunks_processed proves synchronous RT-Embed completion; RTVI-CV connection failures may still be silently skipped
allocated VST and generated ES identities can be observed, but cannot be reconciled to the predecessor's fixed selected-object identity without changing that predecessor
requires one functional fixture spanning VST, RT-Embed, RTVI-CV and all three configured ES index families
backend reports success only when all attempted best-effort steps succeeded; this is not exact tuple-level rollback evidence
exact delayed absence, no reappearance, sentinel preservation and no foreign mutation require receipts not exposed by the current public APIs

steps: delayed exact absence and sentinel check
implementable_exact_subset.reason: Search processing also resolves VST sources and uses model-generated embeddings; raw ES tuples alone cannot prove the selected-object, attribute, fusion and playback semantics.

blocking_findings.fact: The upload contract states that VST returns its own sensorId; the caller supplies a chunk-transfer identifier, not the resulting sensor identity.
The predecessor requires one digest-pinned object_id, sensor_name, sensor_id and timestamp tuple.
RTVI-CV connect and timeout failures are caught and treated as a skip, so a successful completion response does not prove CV fixture creation.
Attribute append results are skipped when VST stream resolution or screenshot enrichment fails.
The public SearchInput forbids extra fields and has no explicit query-embedding field; query vectors are generated by the configured embedding services.
The shipped profile binds behavior and raw Search to fixed 2025-01-01 indices while the predecessor fixture derives per-run index names.
Video deletion continues after individual failures and can report partial or failure; ES removal uses field-based delete_by_query rather than the predecessor's exact six tuples.
The exact 14-action predecessor begins with readback of an already-present fixture and contains no setup actions.

future_binding_requirements: Replace the fixed selected-object fixture with a runtime-allocated identity contract, or expose a production API that creates the exact requested sensor/object identity.
Make RTVI-CV registration fail closed and return a verifiable registration identity.
Expose exact model/index identity and positive per-query embedding readiness in a bounded receipt.
Bind all Search tools to the exact indices populated by the fixture without per-run unreviewed configuration edits.
Expose exact idempotent cross-system deletion plus delayed absence/no-reappearance evidence for VST, RTVI-CV and Elasticsearch.
Publish an additive execution-envelope successor that accounts for setup, reconciliation, failure cleanup and the existing 14 semantic actions.
